mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate indicates monetary easing, which may stimulate economic activity and lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the federal funds rate decreases but the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 40% of the subsequent 20-day periods.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate suggests a strong labor market, which may boost consumer spending and lead to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If the unemployment rate drops below 3.5% but the S&P 500 returns are negative in the following 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts indicates strong demand in the housing market, which may lead to positive economic growth and S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases by 5% in one month
failure_condition: If housing starts increase by 5% but the S&P 500 shows negative returns in the next 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate combined with an increase in CPI suggests tighter monetary conditions, which may lead to negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If both the federal funds rate and CPI increase but the S&P 500 returns are positive in the next 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production suggests stronger economic activity, which may lead to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If industrial production increases but the S&P 500 shows negative returns in the next 5 days.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales (RSAFS) during a period of high consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) suggests weaker demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS decreases by 2% while CPIAUCSL increases by 1%
failure_condition: If retail sales decline and CPI increases but the S&P 500 returns are positive in the next 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) suggests a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If payroll employment increases and unemployment decreases but the S&P 500 returns are negative in the next 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in GDP (GDPC1) indicates strong economic growth, which may lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If GDP increases but the S&P 500 shows negative returns in the next 60 days.
